issues.detail: The Hebrew says Othniel (עָתְנִיאֵל) son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, captured it. The Vietnamese says 'Ca-lem, người em trai của Ca-lem' (Caleb, the younger brother of Caleb), which swaps the name Othniel for Caleb and makes the relationship nonsensical (Caleb is his own brother).
